decisions.statement: An initiative is named by the slug the initiative declares.
A name that is no initiative is refused.
The seat an initiative goes to is the seat named by the initiative's first segment.
An initiative of one segment names the seat of that whole slug.
A seat that has no page is refused in words naming that seat.
A seat whose agent is not present is refused in words naming that seat.
A seat already answering to an initiative takes another initiative all the same.
The assignment stated names the initiative under the initiative page type.
Stating the assignment is left to the mechanical change for a relation.
An assignment reaching no page is refused by that change rather than here.
A run says the commit that run landed.
Every answer here is built by a function rather than written out as a value.
Nothing here reads what a seat already answers to.
Nothing here asks Alan to confirm.
Nothing here starts a seat or stops a seat.

definition: the command handing an initiative to the seat that initiative's name opens with
